arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout. The cron drift issue was due to time zone differences. The failed-jobs backlog was caused by 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which have been deleted. The pgbouncer service has been restarted to ensure smooth operation.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the system for any further issues and ensure that the cron jobs are correctly configured to handle time zone differences.
